facts.statement: Targeted Shared Rural Network delivery is planned to continue through January 2027.
The report expects several satellite-based connectivity solutions to become more widely available across rural England during 2026.
The Digital Inclusion Action Plan was published in February 2025.
The report links connectivity access with digital skills, confidence and local support.
The publication is titled Connectivity and Accessibility Statistics for Rural England.
The edition identified on the page is July 2026.
The publisher is the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs.
The publication page was last updated on 22 July 2026.
The publication applies to England.
The primary digest is provided as a 93-page PDF.
Supplementary connectivity and accessibility data tables are provided in ODS format.
An ODT version of the Statistical Digest is also provided.
The publication is a compendium of connectivity and accessibility statistics for rural and urban areas in England.
The July 2026 release updates Section A on broadband.
The July 2026 release updates Section B on mobile coverage.
Supplementary tables use Rural-Urban Classification categories.
Local Authority tables provide disaggregated datasets where feasible.
The page states that the latest rural broadband and mobile-coverage statistics were published on 22 July 2026.
The ONS indicator is named Gigabit capable broadband.
It measures the percentage of premises covered by a gigabit-capable service.
The indicator defines gigabit-capable as download speeds of 1,000 Mbps or more.
The indicator covers the UK as of January 2026.
The data source is Ofcom.
The indicator was published on 13 May 2026.
